req.title: List all tasks
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/ with a JSON array of all tasks, honouring optional skip and limit query parameters.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the 'List all tasks' functionality of the API. It includes a positive test to ensure the endpoint returns the correct data, a negative test to handle invalid query parameters, and a boundary test to verify the behavior at the limit of the query parameter.

tests.name: test_list_all_tasks_positive
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ without query parameters.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert len(response.json()) == 20
assert response.json()[0]['id'] == 1
assert response.json()[19]['id'] == 20

tests.name: test_list_all_tasks_invalid_query
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with invalid query parameters (e.g., negative skip).
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_list_all_tasks_boundary_limit
actions: Send a GET request to /tasks/ with limit set to 20.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.get("/tasks/?limit=20")
assert response.status_code == 200
assert len(response.json()) == 20
assert response.json()[0]['id'] == 1
assert response.json()[19]['id'] == 20
